title: 1915: the year of failed breakthroughs
subtitle: Gas at Ypres, and a line that would not move
summary: The war of movement ended in November 1914 with seven hundred kilometres of trench and no open flank. 1915 is the year both sides spent finding out what that meant: Neuve-Chapelle, chlorine at Ypres, Artois, Loos, Champagne — a quarter of a million casualties for ground the front-line layer can barely draw. The lesson of the year is the shape of the line at the end of it.

branches.title: What happened
branches.summary: The year as it was fought: four offensives, the first gas cloud, and a front line that ends December within a few kilometres of where it started.
